definitions.explanation: One of the two eyes, used when referring to closing one eye, losing sight in one eye, or something affecting only one side.

examples.japanese: {片目|かため}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つぶった→つぶる：29078_tsuburu⟧。
{片目|かため}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{覗|のぞ}く→覗く：02388_nozoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{立体感|りったいかん}→立体感：21914_rittaikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなる。
examples.english: If you look with one eye, you lose the sense of depth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{片目|かため}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{視力|しりょく}→視力：05033_shiryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{前向|まえむ}き→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}している→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I lost sight in one eye in an accident, but I'm living positively.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ (one of a pair) + ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye). The prefix ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ is used for one of a pair of body parts or objects: ⟦{片手|かたて}→片手：13462_katate⟧ (one hand), {片足|かたあし} (one foot/leg), ⟦{片耳|かたみみ}→片耳：26319_katamimi⟧ (one ear).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片目|かため}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つぶる→つぶる：29078_tsuburu⟧: to close one eye (also means to overlook)
- {片目|かため}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look with one eye
- {片目|かため}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose one eye
- {片目|かため}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close one eye

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{片手|かたて}→片手：13462_katate⟧: one hand
- {片足|かたあし}: one foot/leg
- ⟦{片耳|かたみみ}→片耳：26319_katamimi⟧: one ear
- ⟦{両目|りょうめ}→両目：21275_ryoume⟧: both eyes — the counterpart
